name: MonarchCareersJobList
title: CareersJobList
wrapsNative: LazyVGrid of card Buttons; .sheet(item:) with a NavigationStack and ScrollView for a role's details; Link for apply and mailto
summary: Open roles as cards (team, title, where and how the role is worked, salary, summary and skills); a tap opens the role's details in a sheet with the apply link and an email option.
whenToUse: On a careers or about screen of an app that lists open roles.
whenNotToUse: For applicants and hiring pipelines inside a recruiting product, use a List or MonarchDataTable. For one role, show its details screen directly.
api: init(jobs: [MonarchCareerJob], columns: Int = 2, organizationName: String? = nil, contactEmail: String? = nil, showsHeader: Bool = true, labels: MonarchCareersJobListLabels = MonarchCareersJobListLabels())

MonarchCareerJob.init(_ id: String, title: String, department: String? = nil, location: String? = nil, employmentType: String? = nil, experience: String? = nil, salary: String? = nil, summary: String? = nil, responsibilities: [String] = [], qualifications: [String] = [], mustHaveSkills: [String] = [], niceToHaveSkills: [String] = [], benefits: [String] = [], applyURL: URL? = nil)

MonarchCareersJobListLabels.init(title: String? = nil, empty: String? = nil, viewDetails: String? = nil, responsibilities: String? = nil, qualifications: String? = nil, mustHave: String? = nil, niceToHave: String? = nil, benefits: String? = nil, apply: String? = nil, applyByEmail: String? = nil, emailInstead: String? = nil, close: String? = nil, applyingTo: String? = nil)

options.name: columns
options.description: Columns at regular width, from one to three; one on a phone and at the accessibility text sizes.

options.name: organizationName
options.description: The employer, named above the apply actions ("Applying to Northwind").

options.name: contactEmail
options.description: An address to apply to: "Email instead" beside Apply now, or "Apply by email" for a role without an apply link.

options.name: showsHeader
options.description: Shows the title and the count.

states.name: roles
states.description: A heading, the count ("3 positions") and one card per role with a trailing chevron.

states.name: details
states.description: A sheet with the role's title, meta, summary, responsibilities, qualifications, skills and benefits, and the apply actions at the bottom.

states.name: empty
states.description: The heading and "No open roles right now. Check back soon."

appearance: Cards use the surface colour with the subtle border; departments are captions in small capitals in the subtle text colour; titles use the subheading role; meta, salary and summary the muted text colour; skills are small MonarchTags. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web CareersJobList opens a role in a dialog, writes JobPosting structured data for search engines and can render links with the app's router. On iOS a role opens in a sheet, the apply link and the email open with the system, and there is no structured data. The count is "1 position" or "N positions" from two strings. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: The title has the header trait; the count is read after it.
Each card is one button read as the title, the team, the meta items, the salary and the summary, with the hint "View details".
The details sheet has a Close button, a heading for each section, and the apply link and email link at the bottom.
The chevron is decorative and hidden from VoiceOver.
edgeCases: The summary shows two lines on the card and in full in the details.
A role with no apply link and no contact email has no apply action.
Roles with the same id share an identity; give each a distinct id.

examples.title: Roles with apply links and email
examples.code:
MonarchCareersJobList(
    jobs: [
        MonarchCareerJob(
            "j1",
            title: "Product Designer",
            department: "Design",
            location: "Remote",
            employmentType: "Full time",
            experience: "3+ years",
            salary: "USD 90,000 – 120,000",
            summary: "Shape how teams plan and track their work, from research to shipped flows.",
            responsibilities: ["Design new flows end to end", "Run research sessions with customers"],
            qualifications: ["Three years of product design", "A portfolio of shipped work"],
            mustHaveSkills: ["Prototyping", "User research"],
            niceToHaveSkills: ["Motion design"],
            benefits: ["Learning budget", "Flexible hours"],
            applyURL: URL(string: "https://example.com/apply-designer")
        ),
        MonarchCareerJob(
            "j2",
            title: "Support Specialist",
            department: "Customer support",
            location: "Lisbon",
            employmentType: "Part time",
            summary: "Help customers get the most out of the product.",
            mustHaveSkills: ["Written English", "Patience"]
        ),
        MonarchCareerJob(
            "j3",
            title: "Backend Engineer",
            department: "Engineering",
            location: "Hybrid · Berlin",
            employmentType: "Full time",
            summary: "Build the APIs that power scheduling and billing.",
            mustHaveSkills: ["TypeScript", "PostgreSQL"],
            applyURL: URL(string: "https://example.com/apply-backend")
        ),
    ],
    organizationName: "Northwind",
    contactEmail: "jobs@example.com"
)
